correctness.rationale: For a regular six-simplex, every support meets a vertex; normalize edges to 1 and contact at 0. Its Gram inverse 2I-(2/7)J gives A^2=[2(Q-1/7)]^-1 in normalized nonnegative vertex heights. The reflected-hull volume follows integration over upper projected facets, leading to R=2[Q_I-(8/7)t+(m+1)/7]/(Q-1/7). For m in {1,...,5}, conditional Cauchy equalization of complementary heights and fractional derivative sign of Q_I reduces to F_m(t); m=0 gives R<=12 and m=6 impossible. Independently differentiated each F_m and checked all admissible radical maxima, showing m=1 gives R=6+2sqrt(511)/7. The unique m=1 ratio is (29-sqrt511)/11; 7 possible contact vertices times 6 small-height vertices gives exactly 42 supports. Separately independently constructed seven reflected vertices and verified six-dimensional ConvexHull ratio 12.458659745975591 vs exact 12.45865974597561. Finite/float hull is not the universal proof.
